name: nGZSceneGraph::cLevelInfo::Create
notes: Standalone shape (SX). The director's factory for class 0xed534136, hooked. SG_LevelInfo_ReadWrite builds both levels of each seed through it (game factory on one side, ours on the other) and compares every later step. Mutants (SX): see Read / Write / Assign.

notes: Hooked (the compiler's constructor, /alternatename SX_cLevelInfo_Constructor; flag 1 = most derived). SG_LevelInfo_Construct: built on a 0xcd buffer, words compared (vtables aside), then every slot through the object's own vtables and the in-place destructor.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cLevelInfo::cLevelInfo (width, height, format)
notes: Hooked (SX_cLevelInfo_SizedConstructor). SG_LevelInfo_Construct: formats -1..10, widths and heights 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 255, 256, 1023, 1024, -1, -4, -5, 0x10001 (the DXT block rounding is signed). Mutants (SX): rgb24 pitch x4, DXT1 pitch unsigned, DXT5 falls to default, word format byte count x1 (all killed).

name: nGZSceneGraph::cLevelInfo::Assign (copy of the size words, flag and pixels)
notes: Hooked (cLevelInfoAdapters::Assign; called by cTSTextureRecipeImageData). ORIGINAL-BUG reproduced: the pitch is copied from the other level's byte count. SG_LevelInfo_ReadWrite: three assigns a seed between levels of random sizes either side of the 0x1000 threshold, and self-assignment. Mutants (SX): pitch bug fixed, flag not copied (killed).

name: nGZSceneGraph::LevelPixels::Resize (cLevelInfo's pixel buffer: new[] below 0x1000 bytes, VirtualAlloc from there)
notes: SG_LevelInfo_ReadWrite: sizes 0, 1, 16, 64, 0xfff, 0x1000, 0x1001, 0x2b00, 0x4000 and random, the same size twice; VirtualAlloc / VirtualFree faked (impfx, one arena at the same address on both sides) and their arguments compared, heap blocks counted. Mutants (SX): free threshold <=, VirtualFree flags, no same-size shortcut, alloc threshold >, alloc without top-down (killed). Lane VX (O): VirtualAlloc / VirtualFree called through their owned import slots (game/import_slots.h); mutants swapping the two slots killed (2).

name: nGZSceneGraph::cLevelInfo::QueryInterface
notes: SG_LevelInfo_Construct: the self iid 0x0d54228e, the cSGResource iids, others, a null out, through the primary and the virtual base's vtable; result, out offset and count compared. Mutants (SX): null out passed on, no AddRef (killed).

name: nGZSceneGraph::cLevelInfo::~cLevelInfo (deleting)
notes: SG_LevelInfo_Construct (flag 0, in place) and SG_LevelInfo_ReadWrite (the last Release, flag 1): VirtualFree calls and the heap blocks left compared.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cLevelInfo::Read
notes: SG_LevelInfo_ReadWrite: 200 seeds x 6 reads from a raw-vtable persist reader over generated streams (record versions, names short and long, byte counts either side of 0x1000); the reader's calls, the object's words and pixel checksum, the record name's count compared. Mutants (SX): pitch and byte count read swapped, record name not released (killed).

name: nGZSceneGraph::cLevelInfo::Write
